test_rename_does_not_affect_sequence.title: Verify renaming a tab leaves the numbering of the next tab alone

steps.action: Hover the first tab, click its pencil icon, type Custom Name and press Enter.

steps.expected: The new tab is named View 2, so the rename did not take its number.

test_save_empty_view_shows_error.title: Verify saving a view with no cameras is refused

steps.action: Add a tab and leave it empty, then click Save.
steps.expected: The app shows an empty-view message. If it shows none, it must not show View saved successfully either.

test_save_view.title: Verify a view can be saved with content using checkbox selection

steps.expected: Views page loads with camera grid

steps.action: Add a new tab and rename it with a unique timestamp name
steps.expected: New tab is created and renamed

steps.action: Expand 'Driver Site' in the camera tree and show cameras
steps.expected: Camera list for Driver Site is visible

steps.action: Select the first available camera via checkbox
steps.expected: Camera is added to the view (thumbnail appears)

steps.action: Clean up: close the tab and delete the saved view from My Views

test_open_my_views.title: Verify the My Views panel opens

steps.action: On Views, click the My Views icon in the panel bar.
steps.expected: The My Views panel opens and shows its Presets and My Views sections.

test_open_saved_view.title: A saved view reopens from My Views after a page refresh

steps.action: Add a tab, rename it, show the site's cameras, tick the first camera and click Save.
steps.expected: The toast View saved successfully shows.

steps.action: Refresh the browser and open My Views.
steps.expected: The saved view is listed under its name.

steps.action: Hover the saved view and tick its checkbox.
steps.expected: The view opens as a tab or fills a tile.

test_delete_saved_view.title: A saved view can be deleted from My Views

steps.action: Add a tab, rename it, show the site's cameras and tick the first camera.
steps.expected: The camera lands in the first tile.
The toast View saved successfully shows.

steps.action: Close the tab, open My Views, hover the saved view, click its delete icon and confirm Delete.
steps.expected: The toast Successfully deleted shows and the view is gone from the list.
